purpose: Topic-specific decorative editorial illustrations. Care advice is in selectable text with written citations.

images.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a small editorial illustration for Puptime, a puppy-care app. Primary request: a friendly golden puppy arriving home, sitting beside an open canvas bag containing a folded green blanket and a coral ball, with a tiny house silhouette behind. Style: charming hand-drawn gouache and colored pencil, slightly irregular dark forest-green outlines, flat shapes with subtle paper grain, contemporary children's field guide rather than cartoon emoji or glossy 3D. One golden floppy-eared puppy with white muzzle and chest, small dark nose and eyes. Palette: forest green #176B52, buttery yellow, soft coral, sky blue, warm ivory. Composition: square canvas, a single uncluttered scene, centered subject large and instantly readable at thumbnail size, generous margin around all edges. Warm ivory background #F5F3EC. No writing, letters, numbers, watermark, branding, decorative sparkles, border or UI. High-quality finished editorial art, not an app mockup.
